Two precision defects: (1) 'SEA runs the league's most run-heavy, slowest-possession offense (52.9% pass rate, 32nd; 58.6 plays/g)' — the bundle ranks SEA 22nd in plays/g and calls it 'slow', not slowest; the brief also drops the (22nd) rank while asserting the superlative. Rewrite as 'most run-heavy (52.9% pass rate, 32nd) and slow (58.6 plays/g, 22nd)'. Same overstatement in tt_split_note ('slowest, most run-heavy') and both tt_modifier reasons. (2) 'plus 3.69 HFA give spread_pff SEA -5.607' does not compute: -(4.8147923-2.89291) - 3.69 = -5.612; the bundle's -5.607 implies HFA 3.685 (nfelo's figure), i.e. pff_meta.hfa_pts 3.69 and cores.spread_pff are internally inconsistent by 0.005 pts (0.002 on spread_core — immaterial to the card). The brief should cite the bundle figure and note the reconciliation rather than assert an arithmetic that does not hold.
